response.sql: WITH media_type_stats AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(1.0 * Bytes / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY MediaTypeId) SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_millisecond) AS avg_media_type_bytes_per_millisecond, AVG(1.0 * track_count) AS avg_media_type_track_count FROM media_type_stats
